text_block_list.text:
With the Mile Championship fast 
approaching, Taiki Shuttle must draw more 
attention than ever to secure Umamusume of 
the Year honors.

Around that time, Taiki Shuttle is handed 
a challenge by Silence Suzuka.

If she could have an "unforgettable" race 
and win against the unstoppable Silence 
Suzuka, she might just become the 
"Umamusume of the Year."

The fate of the "Umamusume of the Year" 
was left to the outcome of the Mile 
Championship!
